about.heading: About
about.description: A short note about how I approach work and product tasks.
about.text: I'm a full-stack developer from Almaty. I like taking projects to the point where they are easy to use, simple to maintain and ready to grow further. In my work, I try to look beyond the code itself: what the user needs, what matters for the business and how to keep the solution simple enough so it does not become a problem later.

production.value: I think about launch, maintenance and real usage while the feature is still being built.
production.name: Result-oriented

architecture.value: I try to keep solutions understandable, predictable and free from unnecessary complexity.
architecture.name: Simple structure

business.value: I consider not only the interface, but also how the project supports sales, operations or internal team workflows.
business.name: Business-aware delivery

communication.value: I like requirements, constraints and next steps to be clear for everyone involved.
communication.name: Clear collaboration
